t: Memo & Translation Of An Article Appearing In The Shun Pao,

pages.en:
CHIN

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 667.
Date 29. 11. 29.

November 28 29.

Dear Colonel,

With reference to your letter of November 19, the article regarding alleged misbehaviour of British soldiers in China, which appeared in the China Times of May 27, 1929 and was reproduced three days later in the China Critic, is a copy of a manifesto issued by the Shanghai District Kuomintang which is notorious for conducting anti-foreign propaganda. There is nothing significant in the fact that this article appeared in the China Times, as it was also published in the other important Chinese daily papers, including the Sin Wan Pao, the Shun Pao, the Eastern Times and Minkuopao on the same day. Owing to the dread of Kuomintang reprisals in the shape of a mail ban or boycott against them, these papers publish Kuomintang matter, which is for the most part trash, without question. As for the China Critic, its policy is to uphold Kuomintang ideals and opinions, and naturally anti-foreign articles are welcome to its columns. There is evidence that the article was instigated by disgruntled foreigners and its style throughout is typical Kuomintang hysteria.

The China Times, 162 Shantung Road, may be reckoned next in importance to the Sin Wan Pao and Shun Pao (the two biggest Chinese dailies) and while articles advocating the abolition of extraterritoriality and enlarging on the misdeeds of foreigners, appear in its columns from time to time, its policy may be said to be one of impartiality or as near to it as one can expect of a Chinese paper in these times when an editor with a mind of his own is shortlived. The staff of this paper is as under :-

CHIN

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处登记室
第 I. O. D. 667 号。
日期：29年11月29日。

1929年11月28日。

亲爱的上校：

关于您11月19日的来信，提及1929年5月27日《字林西报》（China Times）刊登并于三天后在《中国评论周报》（China Critic）转载的关于英军在华 alleged misbehaviour（涉嫌不当行为）的文章，实为上海特别市党部发布的一份宣言的副本，该党部以进行反外宣传而臭名昭著。这篇文章出现在《字林西报》上并无特别重要意义，因为同日其他重要的中文日报，包括《新闻报》、《申报》、《时报》和《民国日报》也刊登了此文。由于害怕国民党采取邮件禁令或抵制等报复手段，这些报纸不加质疑地刊登国民党的材料，而这些材料大多是无稽之谈。至于《中国评论周报》，其政策是拥护国民党的理念和观点，自然欢迎反外文章在其版面发表。有证据表明，该文章是由不满的外国人煽动所致，其通篇风格是典型的国民党歇斯底里。

《字林西报》位于山东路162号，其重要性仅次于《新闻报》和《申报》（两家最大的中文日报）。虽然倡导废除治外法权和详述外国人恶行的文章不时出现在其版面上，但可以说其政策是公正的，或者说是当时环境下中文报纸所能达到的最接近公正的状态，毕竟在那时，有独立思想的编辑往往寿命不长。该报职员名单如下：

pages.en:
Translation of an article appearing in the
"Shun Pao", "Sin Jan Pao", "China Times", "Eastern
Times" and "Min Kuo Pao" of May 27, 1929:

The Shanghai District Kuomintang has issued the
the following manifesto on the subject of the fatal assault
on Chang Yoh Liang by British soldiers on Singapore Road:
"Judging by the atrocious act of British soldiers
in assaulting Chang Yoh Liang to death we are convinced t
that the British soldiers are regarding Chinese as slaves
and their country as an annexed nation. They are insulting
Chinese in a reckless manner and killing Chinese freely.
This is an unprecedented disgrace to the Chinese people.
We do not want to enumerate all the atrocious acts that
have been committed by British soldiers in China. They
have now dared to commit another fatal assault, this time
on one Chang Yoh Liang. This case does not concern the
Chinese people in Shanghai only, but it affects the entire
population of China. We have requested the Ministry of
Foreign Affairs to demand that an apology be tendered, that
the family of the victim be compensated, that the assailants
be dealt with severely and that British soldiers in Shanghai
be withdrawn.
"In view of the seriousness of the case we
earnestly hope that people throughout the country will make
preparations to support our Government in this case. We
must strive for the abolition of unequal treaties, the
restoration to China of the foreign settlements, and the
abolition of consular jurisdiction in order to secure true
independence for China. So long as consular jurisdiction
remains unabolished the rights of the Chinese people will
be left unprotected and so long as foreign settlements and
unequal treaties are in existence the atrocious acts of all
imperialists in China can never be checked. Imperialism can
not be overthrown unless we succeed in abolishing the
unequal treaties, securing the restoration of the foreign
settlements, and abolishing consular jurisdiction. We want
to impress on the revolutionary people in Shanghai that at
the present time when negotiations are being conducted by
the Government we should in no way allow ourselves to be
misled by reactionary elements to do anything to cause the
negotiations to result in failure. We should realize that
many diplomatic cases have failed because of the activities
of reactionary elements. Now in dealing with the present
case of fatal assault on Chang Yoh Liang, we should work with
one accord and under the guidance of the Shanghai District
Kuomintang. In order to secure success for the negotiations
over the Chang Yoh Liang case and to secure equality and
freedom all the people should render assistance in the case
and check the activities of the reactionary elements."

1929年5月27日《申报》、《新闻报》、《字林西报》、《时报》和《民国日报》刊登文章的译文：

上海特别市党部就英军在新加坡路致命袭击张耀良（Chang Yoh Liang）一案发布如下宣言：
“从英军殴打张耀良致死的暴行来看，我们确信英军视中国人为奴隶，视中国为附庸国。他们肆无忌惮地侮辱中国人，随意杀害中国人。这是中国人民前所未有的耻辱。我们不想列举英军在中国犯下的所有暴行。他们现在竟敢再次犯下致命袭击罪行，这次受害者是张耀良。此案不仅关系到上海中国人民，更影响全中国人口。我们已请求外交部要求道歉，赔偿受害者家属，严惩凶手，并撤出在上海的英军。
“鉴于案情严重，我们恳切希望全国人民做好准备，在此案中支持我国政府。我们必须努力废除不平等条约，收回外国租界，废除领事裁判权，以确保中国的真正独立。只要领事裁判权不废除，中国人民的权利就得不到保护；只要外国租界和不平等条约存在，所有帝国主义者在华的暴行就永远无法遏制。除非我们成功废除不平等条约，确保收回外国租界，并废除领事裁判权，否则无法推翻帝国主义。我们要让上海的革命民众铭记，在目前政府进行谈判之际，我们绝不应被反动分子误导，做任何导致谈判失败的事情。我们应该认识到，许多外交案件因反动分子的活动而失败。现在在处理张耀良致命袭击案时，我们应在上海特别市党部的指导下团结一致。为了确保张耀良案谈判的成功，并确保平等和自由，所有人都应在此案中提供协助，并遏制反动分子的活动。”

SECRET.
H.B.M.Consulate-General L...667
Shanghai. 20.11.29
19th November 1929.

My dear Aiers,
An article on the alleged misbehaviour of British soldiers in China
appeared in the "China Times" of the 27th May 1929 and was later reproduced
in the "China Critic" of the 30th May 1929. Have you any information as to the
authorship of these articles? It is known that Agnes Smedley has sent similar
articles to the Free Press of India and the authorities in India therefore
suggest that she was possibly responsible for the effusion in the "China Times".
I should be grateful also if you would kindly let me have brief reports on both
the "China Times" and the "China Critic".

Yours sincerely,
G.H.R. Hallard.

R.C.Aiers Esq.,
Director of Criminal Investigation,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Foreign Section,
For attention please
JW
19/11/29

机密。
英国驻上海总领事馆 L...667
上海。29年11月20日
1929年11月19日。

亲爱的艾尔斯：

1929年5月27日的《字林西报》刊登了一篇关于英军在华涉嫌不当行为的文章，随后于1929年5月30日在《中国评论周报》上转载。你是否有这些文章作者的信息？据悉，艾格尼丝·史沫特莱曾向印度《自由出版社》发送类似文章，因此印度当局建议她可能是《字林西报》上这篇宣泄性文章的始作俑者。如果你能简要报告一下《字林西报》和《中国评论周报》的情况，我将不胜感激。

此致，
G.H.R. Hallard。

R.C. Aiers 先生，
刑事调查处处长，
上海工部局。

外事科，
请予关注
JW
29年11月19日
